title: Add `cargo fmt --check` as the first full-gate stage
outcome: Every TermAl full gate fails fast on unformatted Rust, the same rule Engram already has, and coders format before freezing.
acceptance: The standard full launcher runs `cargo fmt --check` as its first stage, before cargo-check, and an unformatted Rust fixture fails at that stage without the launcher rewriting anything.
docs/test.md describes six stages, and the coder test-execution skill tells coders to run the project's formatter before freezing a candidate, in the same sentence Engram's copy uses.
UI and TypeScript formatting are unchanged, and no new dependency is added.

A registered committed-input full run with the six maintained stages produces a verification_record that records the exact cargo fmt --check stage as Lint, preserves its passed, failed and not-run outcomes, and keeps genuine Test and Build kinds unchanged; formatting without --check and other unsupported commands remain refused.
